turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Hi, this is Rahul, how can I help you today?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Hi, a stone cracked my windscreen and I'm stressed about the cost. How much would I have to pay?

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: I'm so sorry to hear that, that must be really stressful. Before I ask for a few details, I need to let you know that this call is recorded for quality and training purposes. Can I take your full name and date of birth, please?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Elena Petrova, 5 August 1967.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you. And can you confirm your policy number or postcode?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: It's NX9 7PB.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you, that's you verified.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: So, if I've understood correctly, you have a cracked windscreen and want to understand what you'd pay. Is that right?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, exactly.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Is it only the windscreen that's damaged?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, just the windscreen.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, I've recorded all of that on your file.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Let me just check that for you, would you mind if I place you on a brief hold?

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Sure, no problem.

turns.speaker: SYSTEM
turns.text: [On hold 0:43]

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for holding, Ms Petrova, I appreciate your patience. For windscreen-only claims the excess, which is the amount you pay towards a claim yourself, is $50. For other motor claims it's $250.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, that's good to know.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thanks, Ms Petrova. Someone will get back to you.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Okay, thank you.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Just to recap, i've explained the excess that applies.

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Yes, that's right.

turns.speaker: AGENT
turns.text: Thank you for calling Orion Shield Insurance. Have a good day!

turns.speaker: CUSTOMER
turns.text: Thanks, bye.
